description.fun: Snivy is cool, calm and very clever. It soaks up sunlight through the leaf on its tail, which makes it faster and droops when it's feeling unwell, and it handles vines better than its own short arms. Designer Reiko Tanoue drew on a picture book about vine-like snakes but gave it legs to look friendlier. Fans soon nicknamed it 'Smugleaf' for the look on its face.
description.guide: Snivy is a Grass-type, snake-like Pokémon and one of the three first partner Pokémon of Unova. It photosynthesizes with the leaf on its tail, which makes it faster in sunlight, and uses its vines more deftly than its short arms. It evolves into Servine and then Serperior.
description.tagline: A smug little grass snake that runs on sunshine.

description.fun: Servine is fussy about staying clean, and for good reason: its leaves can't photosynthesize when they're dirty. It slides low through the grass, vanishes into the shadows of thick foliage, then strikes back with a masterful vine whip. Its one weakness is its inflated pride, which makes it slow to cooperate with other Pokémon. Ken Sugimori cites the manga The Rose of Versailles as the line's inspiration.
description.guide: Servine is the evolved form of Snivy, a Grass-type Pokémon that keeps its photosynthesizing leaves clean. It moves swiftly through foliage and attacks with its vines, though its pride makes it slow to work with others. It evolves into Serperior.
description.tagline: A proud, spotless grass snake with a mean vine whip.

description.fun: Serperior, the 'Lord of the Forest', can stop a foe in its tracks with a single glare, and it only fights at full strength against opponents unfazed by it. It amplifies sunlight dozens of times inside its long body. Its line draws on Western culture, and its fleur-de-lis chest and paralysing stare may recall the basilisk, the 'king of serpents' of European legend. It's the tallest fully evolved starter.
description.guide: Serperior is the final form of Snivy, a Grass-type serpent known as the Lord of the Forest. It amplifies solar energy inside its body and can halt foes with its glare. Its regal design draws on European nobility.
description.tagline: The Lord of the Forest, with a glare that stops foes cold.
